_read_me: Default assumptions used ONLY when real data (data/*.parquet from the pipeline) is missing. Every value carries a source or is marked as an assumption. Replace assumptions with sourced figures before submission.

kwh_per_customer_month.source: Mode: AMDA continental average consumption per customer, 6.1 kWh/month. High: Brief 03 range of 5-35 kWh/customer/month. Low: assumption.

uptake_share_of_buildings.source: Assumption. Replace with connections / building count measured at Selby sites.

growth_fallback.source: Assumption, used only when no matched villages or meter-based growth paths are available.

design.source: Team engineering rules (GridCast). PSH fallback is used only if NASA POWER cannot be reached.

load_factor_rule.source: Brief 03: household-only mini-grids run near 22% load factor; productive use can raise it to about 40%. Coefficients are a team assumption.

costs_usd.source: Assumptions (PV cost from the team app). Replace with AMDA benchmarking figures or Selby minigridprojects.capex.

tariff_usd_per_kwh.source: Assumption (team app defaults). Replace with Selby tariffs table converted to USD.

fuel_spend_usd_month.source: Brief 03: users spend about $5-20/month on candles, kerosene, batteries and diesel.

grant_usd_per_connection.source: Nigeria Electrification Project PBG: USD 350 per new connection (REA presentation, ESMAP 5th Mini Grids event).
